children: Singh, currently Head HRBP for Tata Steel’s Tubes Division, brings more than 20 years of experience across functions and business verticals

TRF Limited has appointed Shubhra Singh as its Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO), effective 15 September 2026. Singh succeeds Abhijeet Singh, who has moved to another assignment within the TataTatael Group.

According to a regulatory filing disclosed to the stock exchanges on 14 September 2026, Abhijeet Singh ceased to serve as CHRO on 15 September after taking up another role within the Tata Steel Group. The company did not disclose further details about his new assignment.

Shubhra Singh currently serves as Head HR Business Partner (HRBP) for the Tubes Division at Tata Steel Limited. She brings more than 20 years of experience across multiple functions and business verticals within Tata Steel.
Her appointment marks a leadership transition in TRF’s senior management team, with the company bringing in an experienced Tata Steel executive to lead its people function.
In her new role, Singh will take charge of TRF’s human resources function. Her experience across Tata Steel’s business operations provides continuity as the company transitions to new HR leadership.
The appointment also reflects the movement of senior talent across companies within the wider Tata Steel Group.
TRF said the management changes were disclosed in accordance with Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

The filing also referred to the applicable SEBI master circular governing disclosure requirements for listed entities. The company stated that no relationship between either the incoming or outgoing executive and the company’s directors had been disclosed as part of the filing.
With Singh assuming the CHRO role, TRF will now look to her experience across Tata Steel as it advances its workforce, talent and organisational priorities.
